An '''apprentice''' of [[Vaius Antinus]] was buried on the planet [[Aduba-6]]. [[Auselio Gann]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] visited [[Tomb of Vaius Antinus's apprentice|this apprentice's tomb]] at some point prior to [[3641 BBY]]. Both [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were interested in uncovering the tomb's secrets.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
